title: PUBLIC WORKS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to a service agreement with NS Corporation to provide repair and maintenance services for the City’s automated…
text:
[Council File 26-1287]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
PUBLIC WORKS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to a service agreement with NS Corporation to provide repair and maintenance services for the City’s automated vehicle wash facilities.
Recommendation for Council action:
DISAPPROVE the City Administrative Officer report dated August 27, 2026, attached to the Council file, without prejudice because the report includes the incorrect contract with NS Corporation to provide repair and maintenance services for the City’s automated vehicle wash facilities.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Not applicable
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - NOVEMBER 3, 2026
summary: Council is considering a service agreement with NS Corporation for repair and maintenance of the city's automated vehicle wash facilities.
